title: Autotask PSA case sync
use_case: Open an Autotask PSA ticket for each new case, keep it updated with case changes and comments as notes, link it on the case, and complete it when the case closes. For MSPs who run the service desk in Autotask.
trigger: Platform Events, source Case, events Create, Update and Comment Added. Leave When does this playbook run? at Always; the playbook's own settings do the scoping. It can also run by hand from a case.
connections: Unofficial_AutotaskPSA 1.0.0, the Autotask PSA connector from this library: an API user's secret, user name and integration code
Taegis.Case 1.0.5, the case connector Sophos manages, to read the case and save the ticket link
requires: Autotask PSA, an API-only user with a security level that can create and edit tickets and ticket notes, and Sophos Fusion playbooks under Security Operations > Automations
mdr_note: Sophos MDR doesn't run or watch this playbook. With Managed by set to self it leaves Sophos MDR cases alone. If you sync MDR cases, check first that a playbook can save the ticket link on a Sophos-managed case, or every event opens another ticket, and that the notes it copies are ones your customer may see.
rollback: Complete or delete the ticket in Autotask and delete the AutotaskPSA link on the case. Turning the playbook off stops further syncing.
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Not run against Autotask: there was no instance to test with. On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings in a Sophos Fusion tenant, imported with its connector, exported again unchanged apart from the tenant's own fields, and both were deleted. Status, priority, queue and note values are picklist numbers that vary by Autotask account. A case-triggered run is untested: the Cases API refused to create a test case that day.
